evals.prompt: Use the repo-scaffold skill on /work/my-api. It is an existing git repository with a few markdown files already in docs/.
evals.expected_output: The agent loads the skill, locates the skill directory, runs assets/scaffold.sh with --dry-run first, applies it, adds front matter to the existing docs, regenerates the index, and finishes with bash scripts/doc-index.sh --check.
assertions: The repo-scaffold skill is selected and its SKILL.md drives the answer.
A --dry-run is run before the applying run.
Existing docs get type, title, and description front matter before the index is regenerated.
The final verification is `bash scripts/doc-index.sh --check`.
Every flag named exists in assets/scaffold.sh (no invented flags).

evals.prompt: 새 레포 만들었는데 뭐부터 해야 할까? 에이전트가 이 저장소 구조를 잘 파악했으면 좋겠어.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes a scaffolding request without the skill being named, loads repo-scaffold, and walks through dry-run, apply, filling the AGENTS.md description, and the index check.
assertions: The skill is selected even though neither 'scaffold' nor '스캐폴딩' appears in the prompt.
The answer applies the skill instead of describing a generic setup from memory.
The answer asks for or fills in the one-line repository description in AGENTS.md.

evals.prompt: AGENTS.md 랑 문서 인덱스 자동으로 갱신되게 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects repo-scaffold, explains that scripts/doc-index.sh regenerates docs/**/index.md and the AGENTS.md block, and that the pre-commit hook and CI run the check.
assertions: The skill is selected.
The answer names scripts/doc-index.sh as the generator and --check as the gate.
The answer does not propose a hand-maintained index.

evals.prompt: This repo is a mess for agents to work in. Nothing tells them where anything lives. Can you make it agent-readable?
evals.expected_output: The agent selects repo-scaffold and sets up AGENTS.md with the generated docs index and the OKF docs/ tree.
assertions: The skill is selected from an English prompt that does not name it.
AGENTS.md and the generated docs index are part of the answer.

evals.prompt: 우리 팀은 GitLab 을 써. 결정 사항은 ADR 로 남기고, 이슈랑 MR 템플릿도 붙이고 싶어.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects repo-scaffold, runs the scaffold with --forge gitlab or relies on the origin URL, and points to docs/standards/decisions.md for the MADR template.
assertions: The skill is selected.
The GitLab layout is used: .gitlab/merge_request_templates and .gitlab/issue_templates.
Decision records are placed in docs/decisions/ in MADR format.

evals.prompt: We keep hitting the same CI setup errors and nobody remembers the fixes. Set the repo up so solved problems are recorded where the next person will search.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects repo-scaffold and explains that troubleshooting records are issues with the troubleshooting label, searched with closed issues included before debugging.
assertions: The skill is selected.
Troubleshooting is recorded as remote issues, not as files in docs/.
The answer includes creating the troubleshooting label once.

evals.prompt: Write me a docs/guides/deployment.md explaining how we deploy to staging.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes the single document directly. If the repository already follows the OKF convention, it adds front matter, but it does not scaffold the repository.
assertions: repo-scaffold is not triggered for a single-document request.
No scaffold.sh run is proposed.

evals.prompt: Set up a new Rust project with cargo and add a CI pipeline that runs clippy on every push.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses cargo new and writes a CI workflow; it explains that repo-scaffold covers agent-facing documentation structure, not language project generation.
assertions: repo-scaffold is not forced onto a language-generator request.
If the skill is mentioned at all, it is explicitly scoped out rather than applied.

evals.prompt: pre-commit 에 ruff 랑 eslint 훅 붙여줘.
evals.expected_output: The agent configures the linters directly. repo-scaffold installs no linters, so it is not used.
assertions: repo-scaffold is not triggered for a linter setup request.
The answer does not run scaffold.sh.
